item.title: A Radical Theory about the Universe Just Passed Some Key Tests. So... What Does that Mean?
item.description: An alternative model in which the Universe is 26.7 billion years old and needs neither dark matter nor dark energy has held up against several major cosmology tests, according to a new University of Ottawa study.

item.title: Trouble at Mars: NASA's Perseverance rover, Odyssey orbiter halt science work due to glitches
item.description: Perseverance has been sidelined by an antenna issue, and the venerable Odyssey orbiter is dealing with a balky reaction wheel. NASA hopes both can get back to work by the end of November.

item.title: Venus-like conditions reveal how minerals could preserve traces of ancient water
item.description: Venus is one of the most inhospitable environments in our solar system, with surface temperatures hot enough to melt lead and atmospheric pressure nearly 100 times greater than Earth's. Yet its surface may preserve clues to a time when the planet looked much more like Earth.

item.title: Low-viscosity lavas reveal a key to Mars's past
item.description: Since 2021, the Mars Perseverance rover has been roaming Jezero Crater, gathering details about the red planet's geology and hints about its past. On its journey, the rover took close-up images of the Séítah formation, a nearly 4-billion-year-old layer of rock at the base of the crater.
